note: Test prompts for the skill-creator eval loop. No assertions yet.

evals.prompt: make me an infographic of the red-green-refactor cycle for my blog
evals.expected_output: No theme, no DESIGN.md in cwd: asks once for colors, font and signature, offering the reference palette. Draws nothing before the answer.

evals.prompt: draw a comparison between a cache and a database using our design system
evals.expected_output: Reads DESIGN.md, reports the mapping (primary→ink, canvas→paper, accents in order) before drawing. SVG uses only theme colors, previews read.

evals.prompt: blog cover 1200x630 for a post titled 'Your agent forgets everything between sessions'. Use ink #111827, paper #f9fafb, accents #2563eb #f59e0b, font Inter
evals.expected_output: Creates a glyphsprite/ workspace with theme.json holding the given values and font.google, uses CANVAS.cover, one large sprite, title wrapped with M.wrap, PNG frame exported.

evals.prompt: animate how a request goes through a load balancer to three servers, dark background, reference palette is fine
evals.expected_output: Reference theme, new sprites built from catalog ones, animation with a 4 s period and steps(), frames at several instants reviewed.
